reason: I'd probably run the free check on our Telegram export out of curiosity, but paying every month for something I could wire up myself with n8n, ChatGPT and a Google Sheet in a weekend doesn't sit right. My shop's spending isn't big enough for a few duplicate nota to hurt much.
objection: I already have free options: Excel, KasKecil, or a bot I could build. Why pay $19 a month forever for an OCR-to-spreadsheet pipe?
would_change_my_mind: If the free check found real money lost, like duplicate or padded nota from the building-supply shop worth more than a year of the subscription, and it read my staff's handwritten Indonesian nota properly where my own ChatGPT attempts fail.
